_readme: This file is the gallery. Put photographs in assets/gallery/, add an entry to items below, and the page builds itself. Delete an entry to pull it off the site. Nothing else needs editing. While every entry is still a placeholder the page shows the coming soon copy plus empty frames, so the layout can be reviewed. Set show_placeholders to false to hide the empty frames entirely.
